report.title: Field Observation Report — Structural and MEP Systems

observations.observationText: Anchor bolt placement at column base plate BP-3 (grid 4/D): measured position is 1-1/4" from design centerline. Tolerance per AISC §M4.3 is 1" for this bolt pattern. Structural engineer to evaluate whether shimming and re-grouting is acceptable or re-drilling is required.

Welding at HSS beam-to-column connection at grid 3/B, Level 3 — weld appears undersized. Fillet weld leg dimension appears approximately 5/16" per visual inspection; drawing calls for 3/8" minimum. Contractor to arrange third-party weld inspection and submit UT or MT report.

Duct penetration through shear wall at grid line 5 between Level 2 and Level 3: no fire damper installed per mechanical drawings M-341. Mechanical contractor responsible. This penetration cannot be concealed until damper is installed and inspected.
observations.location: Grid 5, shear wall, L2-L3 duct penetration

observations.observationText: Electrical conduit sleeve at slab penetration SP-14 (Level 2 mechanical room): sleeve diameter appears to be 2" where drawing E-102 calls for 3". Electrical contractor to verify and provide cut sheet for installed sleeve; if undersized, sleeve to be replaced before slab pour at Level 3.
observations.location: Level 2 mechanical room, slab penetration SP-14

observations.observationText: Concrete pour at Level 3 slab, grid area 2–5/B–E: curing blankets are in place and appear adequate for current weather conditions (42°F overnight low forecast). No cold-weather action required at this time. Informational — no response required.
